description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Professional and friendly staff
review: Although it took several attempts, Auto Windscreens were incredibly professional and friendly throughout my experience with them. They were booked through my insurance company after I had a crack in my windscreen. They were able to book me in quickly and were punctual. My car is fitted with sensors behind the windscreen and these needed to be calibrated afterwards. After I'd driven half an hour the next day, an error came on saying the sensors weren't working. Auto Windscreens were great and came back with some equipment to try and rectify the issue. This also didn't work and they tried everything they could before having to come again to put in a windscreen from the manufacturer instead, which sorted the issue. Although it was a bit of a faff, the man who came out was friendly and courteous each time.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Great customer care and service
review: Good afternoon,I just wanted to pass on my thanks and appreciation on to Ed for his help today.He replaced the windscreen on my Peugeot 207- LP12 BDZ this afternoon Top customer service.He rang me before arriving, which was a great help. He was very friendly, hard working and efficient.  I'd happily recommend Ed and your company to others.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Fast and Efficient Service
review: Within a couple of hours of me reporting the windscreen chip to my insurance company, I received a call from Auto Windscreens advising that they could get my car in for repair the same day.  On arrival at the repair location, I was greeted by a very friendly man who repaired my windscreen in less than half an hour.Excellent service from everyone.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Brilliant chap called Tom fitted my…
review: Brilliant chap called Tom fitted my screen. Arrived bang on time and did a great job. He even took the time to show me the previous poor replacement from before. He replaced the side screen trims for new, even replaced some missing engine plastic grommets. Cleaned up perfectly afterwards and just a genuine nice guy. Highly recommend him

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Perfect service of window replacement
review: Very polite staff, easy booking through insurance company, was offered tea or coffee while waiting. Window screen replaced with speed and care

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: auto windscreens fantastic
review: The whole thing from start to finish was fabulous I rang my insurance company they told me it was £60.00 excess they got auto windscreens to call me literally it was 10 minutes for them to call and it was booked in for a week later as there was no urgency

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Excellent service
review: Excellent service , can’t fault from start to finish ,  friendly staff , and the man who sorted my repair from the company went beyond , fitted my windscreens as soon as possible , can’t fault them at all Gill

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Fast Windscreen Repair Service on Isle of Wight
review: Rapid friendly and professional response from your Isle of Wight sub contractor, Islandwide Windscreens Ltd who contacted me same day and arranged for repair the following day at their Wootton repair unit.  The repair job only took 10 minutes and the I was on my way again

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Super fast windscreen repair service
review: Booked the windscreen repair for the following Monday (a few days hence) and before I'd even hung up, the local centre carrying out the repair called to say they could actually fit it in that afternoon - which they did.I can still see the repair, but that's to be expected.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Professional and polite
review: They were polite, offered me tea or coffee and asked if I wanted to watch the tv whilst i waited. They explained what the possible cause of the crack could have been and gave tips for ensuring the new windscreen would stay durable for longer. Definitely would recommend. ☺️

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Top marks for Grimsby centre
review: The service centre at Grimsby were fast efficient a friendly.My only problem was with the mixed text messages coming from Auto windscreens.Two with different times, and at least two saying that the technician was on his way to me! When it was clear I had opted to go to the service centre!This resulted me, having to phone Auto windscreens, who then had to phone the service centre to make sure it was as arranged. Very confusing, and needs sorting out.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: really friendly and courteous…
review: really friendly and courteous technicians. full explanations given of work to be undertaken and aftercare. Would have been helpful if there had been better signage in the Waiting area so customers know they have to go through the door marked No admittance/staff only to let someone know they have arrived!

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Due to the nature of the glass it had…
review: Due to the nature of the glass it had to be imported from Europe the delay was not ideal but my local branch kept me informed throughout

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Fitted really well and in good time at…
review: Fitted really well and in good time at our house. Only issue was they car interior dash was left covered in dust and bits from the taking out of the old cracked screen and it would’ve been nice to have had this mess hoovered up.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Screen replacement
review: Work to replace screen was quick,only downside is wiper arm wasn't set properly as it was hitting frame when it rained,but apart from price,service was good

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Whats not to like
review: Prompt arrival for appt, followed by an informed diagnosis which subsequently lead to the joint decision to repair, which was then carried out in good time. Very good outcome

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Booking could be improved
review: The only issue I had was the timings given weren't accurate. It said 8am until I think 10am but the store didn't open until 8.30 and no-where on my email or online did it say this. The staff member was extremely helpful and explained everything well

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: It was exactly that service which i…
review: It was exactly that service which i want i been thankful to autowindscreen staff.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Booking the replacement was…Easy
review: Booking the replacement was straightforward and easy to administer with your staff. All aspects were fully explained with details of most convenient locations provided. The installation took place seamlessly and most efficiently. The only difficulty was in contacting the specific site in Shrewsbury as the local telephone was not answered by staff in Shrewsbury and it proved a bit long winded to resolve the contact with the staff on site. This was the only negative aspect of the whole of my dealings with you. THis is the only reason for 4* as opposed to 5*. I would strongly recommend your company to friends and colleagues.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Replacement windowscreen
review: Staff told me how long it wouldtake to replace the window screen on my car and were spot on with their estimate.  Staff were very pleasant with me and there was a comfortable waiting room with a TV.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Easy to arrange
review: Easy to arrange. Quick fitting. Only issue was getting date for windscreen replacement which was nearly a week.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Windscreen replacement done on time and…
review: Windscreen replacement done on time and satisfactorily.Only blip was I was promised a transcript of a conversation but it didn't arrive.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Seamless and excellent windscreen…
review: Seamless and excellent windscreen replacement service. I was impressed by how quick and seamless the service was. The only shortcoming was that they didn't make it clear from the beginning that I had to pay £100 policy excess thus I became confused when they started demanding payment after I had booked an appointment with their service centre. I had to wonder whether I was about to be scammed although it did turn out to be legit.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: All good.
review: Bloke who came out to my house was spot-on and repaired my van windscreen in dire conditions.Rep on the 'phone was a big soulless.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: We were grateful for the engineer's…
review: We were grateful for the engineer's visit when he was clearly unwell and he knew his stuff.  The loss of a star was simply because we received next to no notice of postponement of the initial date for the windscreen to be fixed but were told that the work could be done in Stoke - so clearly there was someone able to do the work but no willingness to do it on site as promised for which we had postponed being away in order to be present to get the work done.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: The staff were very friendly and…
review: The staff were very friendly and helpful.The new windscreen cracked as they were fitting it so I had to wait another week to get it fitted. A little bit inconvenient but was still able to drive my car without any problems.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Front screen chip rep
review: I appreciate the effort of the work your technician carried out on my Ford Puma.  I think I was expecting an invisible repair. I realised due to the size of the chip this was not possible. Thanks again will be in touch reference having a new screen fitted

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Altogether good experience
review: Really prompt, friendly, got the glass replaced.Although window doesn’t work properly, dent in window metal frame made by police was apparently unabled to be fixed by them

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Helpful and timely.
review: Helpful and timely.Had to return for a slight adjustment - these things happen - and again - excellent timeliness and organisation.One star missing - you need to get wifi in the waiting room!

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Overall very easy to get my windscreen…
review: Overall very easy to get my windscreen replaced. Everyone I dealt with was friendly and helpful.  I've not given top marks because the web site wouldn't allow me to book the work to be done at home, due to calibration requirements.  However, after phoning that was checked and I did get a home appointment.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: On the whole an ok experience
review: On the whole an ok experience. Great on the phone when arranging the booking. Then on the the day of the appointment, I got a text message to confirm a two-hour window and after a few minutes a new text message with an apology and a new 2-hour slot. Guess at which slot they turned up? The first, cancelled one of course!Re the installation itself, the rear wiper has been put back badly and I now have to go to my garage to have it fixed. Cleanliness-wise, lots of shards and large glass pieces were left behind in the boot. Other than that, good.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: After hearing something starting to…
review: After hearing something starting to rankle i found that he clips from the bulk head panel wre not put back and  are missing so i will now have to go out and buy new ones

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: No refreshments!
review: I was informed when I initially contacted the firm that tea and coffee would be available in the waiting room. There wasn't any and when I enquired was told we don't provide any!!Apart from that which was misrepresentation the technical side was good as far as I'm qualified to see.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Arrived on agreed time.
review: Fitted the windscreen ok but left chips on the paintwork on the sides and top of the windscreen. There were dirty handprints around the windscreen in the interior of the car as well. He arrived on time and was polite.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: The first fitter called me at 8.45am on…
review: The first fitter called me at 8.45am on the day he was due to be with me at 1.45pm to tell me he wouldnt get to me by 3pm and if it wa sdark or raining he couldnt fit the windscreen--clearly had no intention of keeping the appointment. After calling the Auto windscreen number "Mick" proved less than helpful. I tried to go on line and rebook the appointment but couldnt because the fitter hadnt informed anyone he wasnt coming and so the "appointment" was still live at 6.30pm (dark at 4pm). I called the office again and asked to speak to a manager- I got Jonny and he was very good-professional and friendly and said he would expedite a new appointment but it would probably not be next day. Next morning I got a call and an appointment was set for the following morning--I was going to be first call at around 9am. Later in the day I got a text message saying appointment would be between 8.40 and 9.10am. The fitter arrived at 9.30am. When the job was finished the fitter left around 10.45am. NExt day I noticed black marks on the inside windscreen trim--black glue "finger marks". I complained to the office. I asked for a formal investigation and an explanation. I got a call from AutoWindcreens apologising for the issues, crediting me the £100 excess I had paid to AW and telling me if I couldnt remove the marks AW would provide a brand new screen trim. So the end result has softened my view SLIGHTLY. I still dont have answers as to why the first fitter didnt show and I had to amke a lot of calls and waste a lot of time because of the issue but at least the Senior Managers tried to make amends

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: 2 different delays was frustrating…
review: 2 different delays was frustrating especially second delay as excuse was no windscreen which should have been ordered and in place for the first delay but once arrived efficient and happy

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Could have been great.
review: I would have given 5 star due to ease of booking and speed and the overall service given. Unfortunately I have had to lower to 3 stars due to a major error of accidental damage after the engineer placed a removed part from the car underneath it and subsequently drove over it before completing the work.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Initial problems but sorted quickly
review: Arrived to find out the “system” had ordered the wrong screen even though they booked it - and having driven 15 miles to the centre it was not ideal - they managed to get the correct screen and install it later that day - just a lot of to-fro to get it done and wasted journeys

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Start to finish experince
review: The booking system and questions gave false info. New windscreen recommended when the technician attends it was a chip repair. £75 excess had already been taken from my account. Technician was friendly and knowledgeable.Technician said his info should trigger a refund. I had to chase them 2 weeks plus later to start the refund process of my £75 that’s has now arrived.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: I can hear the wind sound inside the…
review: I can hear the wind sound inside the car while driving on motorway.It didn’t before the replacement.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Reason for 3 stars
review: Reason for 3 stars : technician seemed in a hurry! Left broken glasses all over my drive and into footpath! And I had to re hoover inside my car cause he didn’t clean out shards of glasses properly and it’s a health hazard! I had to sweep out my drive and footpath! In short, he wasn’t up to per with his performance  as a professional. Moreover I provided him cup of coffee cause it was freezing outside!

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: It took an absolute age to sort.
review: It took an absolute age to get the chip in our windscreen mended. It was the admin side of things, not the technician...couldn't fault himThey got three stars instead of two from me, because they did display some commonsense in their eventual solution.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Appointment was at a suitable time and…Good service  just needs to be more customer Inforamtion on arrival .
review: Appointment was at a suitable time and staff helpful , what was missing when entering the branch ,there is no customer signage or directions ,simply a waiting room , so had to find the staff myself .

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Cracked new screen set in very hot weather. After a horrid experience when someone…
review: After a horrid experience when someone had attacked my windscreen for no reason with a screwdriver one evening, the first replacement screen that w/e done on a boiling hot day in the bright sunshine cracked from the corner after curing the next day. I think it should be done in shade to offset this expansion and contraction during the sealing. I then had to wait for a week watching this next crack very gradually   creep until the glue was properly set before it could be replaced. Now I'm happy with the final product, thanks.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Advice on collaboration
review: Your guys did a fantastic job. However, I took the option to have the repair at my home address but then when your guy finished replacing the windscreen I had to take my car another day to your garage to have something collaborated. Had I known this I would have taken my car to your premises at the start and saved myself a day.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Wipe marks on screen
review: Sadly I had to go to them, costing me a bit of time and fuel, not an issue… But after 1 week, I’m still trying to rub off some sort of marking (glue or whatever) that the new windscreen has on it, I don’t know what the technician used to wipe the new screen, but it got wipe marks on it, clearly visible if the windscreen is misted up a bit… even tried sticker remover, and no change…Auto windscreens, how can we sort this?

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: The fitter was excellent however they…
review: The fitter was excellent however they took the excess same day we reported the fault then it took 10 days to have the screen fitted, they use their own suppliers but suzuki could get us a screen the next day, I don't think it was great service leaving 2 disabled people with a car that long. Also they kept saying it was safe to drive without seeing it and police said its not and we could be fined. The screen was cracked from top to bottom.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Mixed
review: Mixed. Over literal interpretation of data protection somewhat painful, funny/farcical. My wife is primary account on the insurance. Two visits as the first replacement windscreen was broken putting it in.  On the plus side very slick admin & notification and unlike other companies they actually dealt with the fitting when you turned up at to your appointment.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Wrong glass delayed replacement.
review: Wrong glass delayed replacement.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Wrong Window
review: I arrived at the place in Roche and they had sent the wrong window. A temporary fix was put into place, but then had to wait for a home visit the following day

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Failed to secure tailgate panelling…
review: Failed to secure tailgate panelling correctly. Failed to vacuum broken glass in tailgate. Securing screws at an incorrect angle. Glass particles in tailgate lock, resulting in a further expense of £100 - on top of the original excess via insurance. Sent incorrect wiper blade for tailgate window (that was refunded, but despite initial cost of £11, I was refunded £9). All in all - not a great experience

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Technical difficulties
review: Arranging a fitting time was very easy. The rep was helpful, efficient & kept me informed. The actual fitting should have been just as straightforward, but the technician seemed to have had problems getting the canopy door to shut. He relied on bringing the door down hard, but it still didn't latch on one side. I couldn't wait any longer, and he appeared to have done all he was prepared to do. I took the vehicle home and found he had failed to adjust the RH latch correctly. Using force to try to close the canopy door had just resulted in him creasing the trim. I made some adjustments myself and the door now shuts with ease. I shouldn't really have had to do his job for him. Using force to try to shut the door would have resulted in another smashed glass. It just required a little diagnosis to establish the reason for the door not closing.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: The job that was done on fixing the crack on my windshield
review: The job that was done on fixing the crack was subpar. I checked online videos of how to do it myself and it turned out to be very simple and much cheaper. The finish you get my doing it yourself is much better than the job they have done. A vacuum needs to be applied which gets rid of the air, which gets rid of the mark. This was not done and now the mark is very visible.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Dissapointed
review: I was disappointed that firstly I had to travel to get my screen replaced and then not replaced with a screen that did not have a screen UV filter but a plain screen. I only had the car brand new for 3 months before receiving a chip that developed into a crack and had to take time off work. It is functional so I have left it as connot deal with the inconvenience.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: I booked for 4th of December and was…
review: I booked for 4th of December and was actually given the 11th and waste 2 days holiday, had even got my girlfriend to confirm I was booking the 4th before I confirmed the appointment, would use Autoglass in the future

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Awful organising, but good install
review: Great install and service by installer. Awful head office arranging the install.. asked where is the car parked? Replied “on the road outside my house”. On day of installation the installer stated they could not install at the road side. Had to have 4 more days with a “sealed” window (cling film provided).Final fix was great, the journey there less so!!

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Unreliable
review: Traveled to the Tunbridge Wells site to get my windscreen replaced, taking time off work to do so. They got the wrong windscreen in not once but TWICE! The manager was unprofessional and couldn't care less. Tom, who actually fitted it (on the third visit) was great and very embarrassed. If you want reliability, don't use this company. We had no choice as it went through our insurance.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Auto Windscreen poor service
review: The service from Auto Windscreens was very poor. I paid £150 excess and it took two weeks to replace my window. I was informed on every occasion that they were short of staff. After a week they said someone would come on Friday and they supposedly took ill on the way. They offered me the following Tuesday but I didn't trust them so I said I would go their depot on Monday as long as they ensured the glass would be there. After travelling for over an hour in cold weather with no passenger window they phoned me to say the glass wasn't there but they would fit a plastic one. That done I was told I would be contacted later in the day with a new appointment. I had to call them the following morning as no-one had contacted me. Finally I got an appointment and they came and fitted the new window on the Friday. All those I spoke to were very sorry but that was not good enough service. Please note the date of experience may be a week either side.

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Great repair but dreadful appointment arrangements
review: Repair was done fantastically and garage staff were very helpful but the organisation of the appointment was dreadful. Despite asking for full information over the phone wasn’t told the repair would be 1.5hours so only found when arrived. Plus Appointment Time changed on me without any consultation. Waiting area cold, uncomfortable, no wifi. Hope I don’t have to use this again!

description: A leading automotive glass repair and replacement company in the UK
title: Not impressed
review: The technician cracked my windscreen while repairing a small chip.  Had to visit their depot in Oldham to have it replaced.  Had to pay increased insurance excess.   It was 40 mins after my appointment before they even looked at the car then 2 hours to replace the screen.  Had to wait in a cold, uncomfortable waiting room with no facilities such as a drink.

I think they're slightly more expensive fare option allows more flexibility, but if you're booking a ticket and they give you the option of $100 inflexible and $110 flexible, rarely would I happily pay the extra 10 bucks. I'd rather not even have that ultra basic fare option, just charge me the $110 and be flexible in case I need it. Overall though, very good company with great service. Being from Western Canada, good adequate available public transit is pretty much an unheard of for me so I really appreciate all the options that the UK has available

My experience is that P&O have been more reliable than Stena on arrival times however Stena's boats and terminals are more modern and nicer. Up to now the deciding factor for me has been the free parking at the P&O terminal in Cairnryan. This has now changed to a £6 per day charge which will now sway my decision back to Stena. On my most recent trip on 19th December there was a 40 min delay to the P&O sailing - I think caused by factors outside P&O's control (weather and heavy traffic arising from Holyhead closure). However, the delay was well managed and communicated by P&O.

title: Impersonal, inefficient and chaotic food service
review: I have avoided P&O since the “mass sacking” a couple of years ago, but decided to give them another try on a recent crossing from Calais to Dover.The ferry was more-or-less on time and was relatively new. However, I was shocked by the service offer. An impersonal, inefficient and chaotic self-service system for hot meals - we paid £35 for two portions of fish & chips plus a small soft drink each. I don’t know where to start. Whoever could have thought this was a good idea? It just reeks of trying make a quick buck with no respect for or interest in customers’ needs. Older passengers with walking sticks and mobility aids were having massive problems with this system. I was polite to the one man who was calling out the numbers and passing over the trays, but really felt for him - he had an awful job on a crowded ferry and was probably being paid a pittance.Everything is served in “throwaway” containers - great for sustainability, P&O!An awful experience - won’t be using P&O again.

title: Mixed experience
review: Mixed experience. On one occasion prior to COVID I booked a cruise and it was lovely. Leaving it there I'd have left 5 stars. However we Booked a cruise and then COVID hit. Not the companies fault but give me my money back and we will wait together for it to blow over or allow me travel at a later date when things return to normal.  P&O initially refused to refund me as it was a non refundable ticket  even though I could not physically travel due to the restrictions. I said I'd travel if the ship sailed and they said they could not do that. Now I understand that as COVID was rife. After back and forth and many emails they eventually gave me a credit note but the prices of the cruise increased so we were informed we had to pay more than what we originally did to travel. It was a time p and o were under heavy criticism for how they treat staff and customers. In the end we accepted the loss and to this day never executed the offer of a credit towards what would have been a more expensive trip eventually. Not booked with them since. I wouldn't say I would never use again but it's evident they have questionable practices towards those that keep them afloat.

I have since been refunded but this was done without an explanation or apology. I doubt that I will travel P&O again. A shame as I wanted a better option than Eurotunnel

It was trial and error until I found what I wanted and each time I had to fill in the passenger information form before I could see what was really available. However, as soon as I had the crossings, things went smoothly.

It took 2.5 hours to reach the ferry booth to get hour ferry lane ticket. The person at the counter never mentioned our ferry was delayed to midnight until we checked our lane ticket. When I questioned him he said next available at midnight( 1.5 hours late) boarder agency clearance took 30 minutes. Took 4 hours to reach the ferry terminal. When we reached home( in London)  it was 4am which messed up our morning work plan.

The bike arrived and I had a few short rides to get the fit and feel right. The website allows seat reservations only on the older ships (eg Normandie), but only cabins show for the new replacements. A little confusing unless you know. We are looking forward to sailing onboard in 2025.

title: À mixed bag between Manchester and Paris
review: A mixed bag.We travelled from Manchester to Paris and back on the direct service.We had a fantastic team of drivers on the way out.They were very attentive, told us everything we needed to know, including when going through the border, customs...They kept the bus clean, drying the steps so no-one would slip.They worked together very well, for instance when passing through tight spots...On the return leg, the drivers hardly said a word to passengers. Didn't bother to say where toilets were, or telling people to use their seat belts.They didn't say anything about mobile phone use but when my daughter talked to her boyfriend, the non driver told her off in an unacceptable way. Furthermore, their instructions at French border control were unclear which irritated the French security staff who demanded all luggage to be scanned as a result.One passenger was detained at British border control for nearly an hour. The drivers didn't bother to explain what the situation was.When leaving the ferry, the driver made a slight mistake and the right mirror of the bus hit the left mirror of a lorry. No damage done.While I gave our experience 3 stars, I enjoyed the journey and my next trip to Paris will be on-board a Flixbus coach.

title: Ciise saved us from rejected valid ticket!
review: It would be 1-star review if it wasn’t for Ciise!! This guy saved our trip! Appreciate it!Flixbus converted a simple trip to a terrible and stressful experience. My girlfriend and I, had booked 2 tickets, London to Leeds and back for Christmas eve, months ago, due to the probable high demand on that day.When we arrived for the outbound, the driver told us the our QR code is not valid and we do not have seats in that bus, believing we were mistaken. So the bus driver and the manager there did not let us in and our bus left without us!!As it turned out, the tickets were correct and flixbus had cancelled our tickets without any notice or refund (!!!) due to some station name change or system problem, I dont know. So imagine, we had booked and paid probably first of all the passengers of the bus and finally we were the only ones without tickets and staying without bus in Christmas eve!! Imagine the stress, the frustration and the injustice of this situation, without having done anything wrong. It was a clear theft and then ignorance from flixbus.At that point we couldn’t do anything, but fortunately we explained the situation to the manager (probably), who was Ciise, he understood that we were right and acted quickly after understanding the issue. He talked to the bus driver who had already left and agreed that he would wait for us on a next stop where we found him using the subway after 40 minutes! It was a stressful and tiring experience, but at least we managed to find the bus and hop on (without having actual seats, but seating where other previous guys left!)) reaching our destination on time fortunately, thanks to Ciise who arranged the whole thing!He also updated our inbound tickets without any extra cost, because if we had to wait for flixbus support…we would be still there! And he did all that on Christmas day! Thank you Ciise!We have been using flixbus for a lot of trips and we have never faced or expected a situation like that from a trusted company like that. We didn’t expect either to be dependent on one man’s good will.Of course we will ask for a refund and hope such a situation doesn’t happen ever again to us or anyone else.

title: Read this if landing in GVA Terminal 2
review: We travelled from Geneva airport to Avoriaz and back twice with Alps2Alps, in January and February 2024.If you are travelling from a regional UK airport to GVA in winter, you may well land at Terminal 2. Contact Alps2Alps in advance to obtain their confirmation that they will pick you up at Terminal 2. (if they tell you it can take up to 20minutes to drive from T1 to T2 that's  incorrect - drivers can just go through 'Kiss and fly' at T1 and carry on for 90seconds to reach the T2 carpark. title: The return journey went horribly!
review: We booked a transfer from Geneva airport to Courchevel and back. Premium car. The cost of the round trip was €753. The journey from the airport to the hotel went well. The driver was very professional and car was really good! When the end of the holiday approached, we were sick and had to postpone our flight and the transfer. The representative of the company was very friendly, tried to help in everything, gave a small discount. But the new cost was a bit shocking, we had to pay an extra €312 (in fact, almost the cost of one trip). But the most important thing is that the car we were given was defective. The heater didn’t work! All 2,5 hours we travelled with the child in an absolutely cold car! We put on all the warm clothes we had, hats, mittens, Uggs, but it was terribly cold. Even the driver's windscreen was fogging up, he was wiping it with a rag, visibility was very bad. It is very dangerous on the road in the dark and on the serpentine. We asked the driver several times to make it warmer, he pretended to do something, but nothing changed. We barely made it to the airport, our kid was terribly cold!

title: Bromley Kwik-Fit - Hitting A Man When He's Down.
review: It's not very often that a bad review is necessary - and I always leave twice as many good reviews at least.So here goes.Having managed to trundle my car with a flat nearside - on its rim - to a near and open garage during Twixmas - thank you Google; the chosen garage unfortunately didn't have my tyre size.So I pootled off to a tyre factor - and stumbled on Kwik-Fit, which was too far to drive to in a Donald-Ducked car. On entering, two guys we're sitting at desks, one on the telephone, so I stood in front of the chap who seemed to be writing on boxes of air filters, or some such. I stood there, and stood there, and stood! I knew he must have known I was standing there - the door's noise announces you! - but he continued with his artwork on the boxes with a very thick felt tip pen! Pointillism, I think.So I asked, "Can you help me please?".(I was hoping Kwik-Fit could provide me with a tyre that I could carry around to where I had come from, thus preventing me having to drive a problem car - who's steering was difficult (and dangerous). The tyre was completely shredded as I had driven, slowly, 3kms on it to get to sanctuary!)The Box-Artist turned out to be named 'Damien' when I asked, but his surname wasn't 'Hurst'.After cutting across his long-winded explanation of why he couldn't just sell me a tyre - I'm afraid I advised that I was here for his suggested solution - not a list of his problems.My demeanor wasn't helped by the fact that a) I was in trouble b) that Damien didn't believe my information that the garage I had come from had tried to phone him for information - and three times checked his mobile - and c) eventually actually phoned the garage to find out, I  believe, if my information was true. His body language shouted "this man is telling Porky Pies". Sans doubt. I think Damien was having as bad a day as I was.Having established - and denigrated me by disbelief - he came up with "it's the best I can do" offerThe best he could do, for a long standing customer on their system?£80 quid for a tyre which included fitting - that they couldn't do! No thanks. And he allowed me to trundle off back to the garage from whence I came! Hitting a man when he's down - Great.Wow! Isn't it reassuring that when you are in trouble, businesses like Kwik-Fit are there to bale you out! And so willingly interrupt their Part-Box artistry to eventually deign to come to your aid. And even if they disbelieve you, they won't show it! Then fleece you.Sir Tom Farmer was renowned for his revolutionary customer-facing ethics when he started in 1971 in Scotland. I have been a long-standing customer for most of that time. But no longer.Many people would suggest that Damien requires a Customer-Facing-Service Refresher course. But I believe it would be a waste of time - he's been on plenty already. He knows how he should be assisting customers in trouble. He knows he has agency not to fleece them - it's a foundation of service inculcated by Sir Tom.Why don't you enrol in art school, Damien?My salvation? The original garage agreed with a much better solution after I had found my way backPostscript - with reference to their reply below I repeat what I said in another place. It's all there in the review - which I stand by btw. I'd be willing to sign an affidavit to confirm its integrity. It's only fair that you get Damien's side of why he chose the unhelpful and exploitative path (clutching at straws, he may contest the £80. It wasn't I rounded it up - but it was £79.60 or something very close.) I just want to put it behind me. You have sent the same response - that was sent in another place. It would seem that all you are interested in is damage limitation. I'm cynically concerned that all you might want to do is to get my review removed, changed, or softened. When in fact you have lost a long-standing, loyal customer. Your representative, Damien, should realise that he represents your company on the frontline. He did so. Badly. (And just read poor 'Claire's' review? Was he involved in that disgraceful service?). However thanks again for your response.

title: Very upset client!
review: I am writing this on behalf of my client who was very upset about her transfer from the airport Flight AC864 landed on 14 Aug 2024 at 10:00am to her port hotel which were arranged by Jayride and assigned to Xpress Airport Transfer.  The issue was that she was at the pick up location and he wanted her to come outside instead of waiting there with a sign. Here are her remarks:When I passed the doors to the arrival section, I saw many transfer companies….clean and fine looking gentlemen and women, dressed professionally in suits, holding up signs with their customers name on it, waiting for their customer as soon as they passed through the doors. I of course walked around in circles, exhausted, dragging around my two luggage's and carry-on bag, looking for my name on any of the placards, with no luck! I then finally found the Travellex money exchange counter on the other end of the arrival area, that was indicated as a meeting point, on the invoice from Jayride (I guess they prefer their customer runs after them, rather than they meet their customer), again nobody was there! No sign with my name on it! As I was scrimmaging through my papers, trying to watch my 3 bags while attempting to find Jayrides contact info, I received a call from the Driver "Ali"! He told me that he was waiting for me somewhere outside because he did not want to have to park his car and come inside! Keep in mind….I'm lugging 3 bags, I'm exhausted and this airport is humongous, I say "where outside?" He said he was driving in circles in the arrival area so that he didn't have to pay parking!!!!! I insisted he come find me with his sign with my name on it because I was not about to start walking around outside, dragging my bags, looking for him! 45 minutes later, I was picked up! A man dressed in what looked like a dirty sweatsuit, hanging off his behind, barefoot in flip flops and looking like he hadn't showered in a week. No sign with my name on it, on hand. I somehow had a sinking feeling in my stomach and thought "Oh God! Please no!" Sure enough, that was my $300 personal transfer! I made him show me his email for proof, since my name appeared nowhere on a placard or anything! Then to top it off, in the elevator on the way to the inside parking garage, he was using the parking ticket to clean his teeth! Disgusting is putting it lightly!!!!!I tried to escalate this with JayRide who were not successful.  It sounded to me that the driver was not there on time and wanted to cover his butt!  The flight was not delayed and there didn't seem to be a reason why he wasn't there to pick her up!

title: Used item received in error
review: I bought a set of mudguards, clearly stated as new, I received a set which were soiled, and were missing all of the mounting hardware too. Contacted customer service and returned them, they refunded me and also refunded the postage costs. Good service considering the mistake.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Great delivery time
review: Great delivery time Excellent price No instructions supplied for bike assembly I was offered a £20 gift card as my bike was scratched but this has never materialised No record of serial number in receipt

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Happy with my purchases, but…
review: The good: Great range of products and competitive prices. The not so good: Slow delivery. Bombardment of sales emails and newsletters.The good outweigh the bad and I will definitely use again.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Wrong Item Delivered
review: Purchased expensive Peaty's Premium All-Weather Bike Lube but received the much cheaper standard version - despite the emailed invoice stating I had ordered and been charged for the more expensive Premium item. LLB advised I return it 1st class while they 'looked into' sending me the correct item (as they weren't sure if it was in stock)! I wasn't prepared to do this due to the inconvenience of returning it at my expense and then waiting for the item I'd already paid for to be in stock and then delivered. I suggested I keep the less effective product and they reimburse me the price difference, which they did pretty promptly, hence the 3 stars.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: The bike I ordered arrived in good time…
review: The bike I ordered arrived in good time and undamaged . It had a significant discount which was good. I didn’t deal with anyone in the shop really so can’t comment on the customer service . But absolutely no complaints about my experience.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Average experience
review: Not too bad for web/mail-order, however it's not clear on their site when items are actually being shipped from a store or a central hub.  I ordered two items both said "in-stock". One arrived relatively quickly but the other took longer and it was not clear at any stage that this was getting shipped separately to the first item or from a store except receiving a random sales invoice PDF from the store with no description or explanation.   After the first item arrived I had to contact customer services to ask about the second item as I had assumed it had just been missed. It was only then they told me it was getting shipped from a store, and then after that I received the aforementioned sales invoice from the shop itself.    Items are absolutely fine, but not a particularly slick experience.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Geat team who bent over backwards to…
review: Great team who bent over backwards to resolve the problems I had with the demo bike. I think I was just unlucky given all the positive reviews.Special mention to Martin.Thank you

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Bike arrived well packaged in good…
review: Bike arrived well packaged in good condition but front right brake wasn’t working and when I called they didn’t want to know and couldn’t help I’d advise to use them only if your local

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: the item was there when you said it…
review: the item was there when you said it would be. that is about it really. I arrived. the staff member was not particularly friendly, he laughed when I suggested showing ID when your email said I should. yeah. whatever.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Despatch time shocking
review: Despatch time shocking, didn’t respond to messages/emails, Why does LL historically give bad online service. Every time I’ve had issues with the retailer online, stores not to bad though. Seems online customer service staff just couldn’t give a damn whenever I’ve had to contact them, and this isn’t an isolated incident either, it’s every time. Yet other shops always get back to me whenever I’ve had to contact them, even when they’ve been short staffed. Leisure lakes take note !

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Ordered a set of 80mm high bars…
review: Ordered a set of 80mm high bars inventory was wrong didn’t have the colour I ordered, organised another colour that they confirmed in. Was sent 50mm risers. Sent back got a receipt through 2 days later with another 50mm bar but wrong diameter. Called up good service from a guy who sorted it out, but still awaiting the bars nearly 3 weeks later from order.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: I'm absolutely disappointed
review: I'm absolutely disappointed! I ordered my parts on Sunday with the promise of dispatch in 2 days! It is now 9pm Wednesday with no dispatch email! I've had to miss a competition due to this 🤬 I relied on the parts being with me today (16/10/24) or at latest 17/10/24. I haven't even recieved an email or call to say it's delayed. Shocking customer service.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Five assistants and only me in shop
review: Five assistants and only me in shop. Ignored while they made each other coffee and chatted. Eventually I asked for assistance but felt like I was disturbing them. Then talked down to and left alone mid way during sales discussion while assistant went of and served someone else.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Horrendous build quality, good customer service.
review: By far the worst build quality I’ve ever seen with lots of careless damage like small dings, scratches and scuffs marks including damage to anodised parts and bent bits of plastic trim.Headset didn’t even fit together and was very obviously loose when I received the bike, stem didn’t even fit over the massive burr so amazing how that didn’t get spotted.Customer service has been good when helping to resolve issues but need to start with the basics.Thankfully they offered to cover the costs when I took it to another bike shop for repair.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Poor online ordering experience
review: Ordered several items online which should have been despatched within 48hrs. Waited days for confirmation, but no email or text. When I called it was obvious they had failed to process the order. They did apologise and upgraded the order to next day special delivery, for free, however, the items were then received individually over the next three days. Disappointing.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: It’s how you put things right that matters
review: So my bike was a couple of days late being dispatched and then their courier sent it to the wrong depot, so I received my bike 3 days later than expected.  I did get an email to say it would be late being dispatched but no indication on how long, so I had to call.  Then when it did arrive it was damaged and I had to make multiple attempts to contact the customer services dept.  I think it was 6 calls, 3 emails and 1 social media message. When I eventually got an email, they said the part should be shipped Thursday so I’d have it by Saturday.  No further contact from them so I emailed again but no response.  Saturday has arrived and no part. I think the customer service department just needs the be better at communicating. I appreciate things get damaged but it wasn’t a cheap bike and I just feel ignored. I didn’t have the option to collect due to distance from where I live to the nearest store.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Return process
review: Product ordered and delivery all good, however returns process not that clearly stated. No print returns label. Had to have an email conversation. Cost me >£12 at PO to return shoes. 'Wiggles' processs is £2.99 and a pre-print a returns label - easy peasy. Sorry- just my experience and wont be using LL online again.

description: Leisure Lakes Bikes are a family run business established over 40 years ago. Our huge online bike store and 14 stores nationwide offer all the latest bikes, clothing, parts & accessories!
title: Orbea laufey 24” loose bars
review: I bought 2 Orbea laufey 24” mountain bikes for Xmas, one of them had a bent gear hanger on arrival (luckily I had a spare) but more seriously the allen bolts holding the handlebars onto the stem / forks had not been tightened sufficiently so it was relatively easy to turn the bars independently of the front wheel. Easy problem to solve but could have caused a nasty crash if I hadn’t spotted it. Don’t rely on the mechanic!

It's good to see them take the feedback seriously.

title: Good service, better communications needed

No further communications until I called the number on the e-mail confirming payment, was told they could not trace my order number or anything in my name, worrying as I'd paid almost £200. Processes need reviewing.

title: Great for tyres, but research any servicing quotes
review: I swore by this branch a few years ago, as the service was excellent when it came to tyres. However, when I took my wife's Mini there for an interim service a couple of years ago, I had a call from them saying that the battery was below par(which I knew anyway), and that it needed a replacement stop-start battery, at a cost of £200+. This was completely wrong, as the car doesn't even have a stop start system, so I politely declined. I was passing yesterday, so popped in out of curiosity, to obtain a quote for replacing the lower suspension arms on my car, which was £500+. Quality replacement parts can be obtained by Joe public for around £100, so I'm wondering what their hourly labour rate is, to justify that cost. I won't use them again, as quite frankly, I was insulted by the quote that I received, and god knows how many people just accept what they say, rather than get a 2nd opinion. I've also had the same experience as others, with regard to online bookings, where I've requested a certain time, only to be asked if I didn't mind leaving the car for the day, as they're behind. Probably not the fault of the staff, but not ideal if you have a schedule to adhere to.

title: Well that's confusing...
review: Booked a slow puncture repair at Stourbridge National Tyre centre. Dropped car off, went back 30 mins later. They said it doesn't have a puncture, they think the valve is leaking but it's a TPMS valve. Right, so obviously I still need it fixed so I said, ok, are you saying I need to get a dealer to do it (as in the official car manufacturer dealer), the response to which was 'yes'. I then told them that I did find a piece of metal (like a nail) stuck in the tyre but I guess you would have seen that when you looked at the inside of the tyre? Response was 'oh, we didn't look inside, we 'just know' (from seeing if there are any bubbles by spraying a solution on the tyre). That's fair enough, but looking on-line, slow punctures don't always produce bubbles because they are ... well, slow...So I get home, google TPMS replacement to find out more and what pops up - National Tyre, we do TPMS service and replacement! Well, I'm confused now. Clearly Stourbridge don't because they sent me away? So do National Tyre fix TPMS valves or not? Let's see if the Marketing department know......

title: Enjoyable...but time consuming!
review: First time Ferry user!  Crossing from Dunkirk to Dover:  Arrived over one hour early and Ferry left over one hour late and ten minutes late from departure time.  Crossing was uneventful, plenty of facilities that were clean and enough food and sights to keep children busy.  Crossing from Dover to Dunkirk:  departed ten mintues late arrived on time...no issues.When taking the Ferry, don't be in a rush...the loading/unloading and crossing takes most of your day, so dont plan on sightseeing!  In all a very good experience, if you have the time and want to save some money versus the Euro Chunnel.

title: 10 point health check at Wellingborough store
review: My friend recommended I go to the Wellingborough Branch and get a free 10 point health check which sounded too good to be true, almost but not quite.A very friendly and knowledgeable chap called Adnan (who gets 5*) carried out the check and identified two tyres needed inflating but all met the required tread depth, two bulbs were out at the back which I had to go back in-store to purchase, return to get the right bulbs as I’d been given the wrong ones,  and then return again to get some coolant which the in-store guys never got the message from Adnan to supply me with. However, I’m back in the road legal and safe. The only negative I would say apart from dancing in and out of the store was the £10 per bulb to change them which I thought was a tad excessive but apart from that I’d definitely recommend the service to family and friends but be aware free is not necessarily as cheap as it might be.

title: I purchased a 4 ton Halfords Bottle…
review: I purchased a 4 ton Halfords Bottle jack in September, 2024, and after the second time in using this, it would not function. I contacted the service helpline - Monday 23rd December - I was advised to return the item to the Halfords store in Loanhead. On Friday 27th December, the staff examined the jack, and they could not get it to function. No problem whatsoever in obtaining a new one - the staff were great and helpful. However, in front of the staff, I opened the box - which was bashed and sellotaped up, the jack was upside down, and the instruction manual had been taken out of the plastic bag - including chips on the base of the jack. This obviously did not leave the suppliers in this condition, but time will tell if this item had been returned, or had been used at some point - photos supplied. I would have given 5 stars, but for the condition of the jack, and it is a 4 hour return journey using public transport from Galashiels.

title: Halfords 1/2/3 Isofix Child Seat Top Tether
review: Delivered promptly. Initially very pleased, 2 seats (Twins) Grand children. Disappointed that no instruction leaflet provided. Regarding on-seat safety labelling, appears to be missing on headrest removal security key. Also, the function of the presumed car seat belt tension device is a bit of a mystery, should it be necessary to fit seats to a non isofix vehicle. Final point, the seat design of my vehicle, benefits from the use of Isofix locator guides (often supplied with other isofix child seats). These did not appear to be listed on Halfords car safety website pages (Ordered from Amazon).The price was excellent and overall pleased with purchase.

title: Poor service incorrect part
review: What went wrong.Having previously told me a van battery was not available when I went for "click & collect", then found one, then fitted it and put the cover back on upside down trapping a cable.I tried again on 2nd January.I ordered a side light bulb holder and bulb with fitting.Having entered my registration to confirm both fitted.On arriving at the same Chesterfield store as previously I was told by woman on desk and a fitter that they didn't/coildn't fit both, only the bulb.I asked them were they sure.They both repeated "no, only the bulb"I then said ... "If you don't , how are you going to fit the bulb, without removing the holder to do so, it is plug and play".They then checked and agreed with me.Fitter then tried to fit new bulb and new holder but holder thicker than original so wouldn't go into light body.He then fitted bulb in my original holder.Light worked.Refund issued for holder.My complaint is two.Why did I have to argue with your staff about fitting when all fitter needed to do was look at new bulb and bulb holder?Why did holder not fit despite me entering my registration and getting confirmation it did on line?Poor initial service at desk.Incorrect information online regarding product.Van = 2005 1.9 Vivaro

title: Very expensive
review: Received seasonal sale notification with 10% off if spent >£30. My car needs new wiper blades, front and back. Opted for Bosch: AR24U @ £21.49, AR13U @ £18.99, and H275 @£13.09. The company keeps dishing out discounts week in week out all year round but their business strategy and pricing is a no brainer.

review: Car seemed to have battery issues on a Sunday morning. Contacted Halfords and was notified of prices for a replacement. Took the car down and had the battery fitted within an hour or so (the weekend before Xmas).AT NO STAGE was I asked which battery option I'd opt for - they just went ahead and fitted the Most Expensive option - which tbh just demonstrated their corporate ethos of "Fleece the Customer for as much as you can while he's in your clutches" mentality.The guy was accommodating enough and I'm grateful that it was at least open on a Sunday which allowed me to address the problem that had arisen.  The automotive trade has a reputation for ripping people off - but from a Customer Care & Transparency angle they fell somewhat short of the standard I'd expect from a National Brand. The place is a purpose built tyre change location (owned and operated by Black Circles), designed to be drive through... but the staff (arriving late, mine was the first job in the morning) parked their car in the exit, presumably for the partial cover since it was raining. This forced customers to reverse out over the ramps and into oncoming traffic in a sharp turn, potentially damaging the ramps, the new tyres, and also posing a danger. I might use Black Circles again, but I will not be using that location.

title: Scott aspect 960 poor bike build.
review: I already made a review about the Scott aspect 960 but I keep finding more faults with the bike. I have had the bike just a few days and only been on it once.Originally I had a problem with the gears. When I am in a higher gear the chain hits the front derailer so the gears have not been calibrated properly. It is annoying as I can’t use the bike the way I would like to. The chain and the bike itself also makes a lot of noise when I am riding on bumpier terrain. Something I have never experienced on other BRAND NEW bikes.The 2nd problem is when you buy a new bike and it gets delivered the handlebars are always 90 degrees to help with delivery. So I moved the handlebars to the correct position but realised the bolts at the stem had been tampered with quite bad I could not secure the bolts tight enough so the handlebars were not 100% locked. Any impact to the handlebars or on a bumpy trail in the future could result in them coming out of position. But lastly and this has now annoyed me a lot. After riding the bike only 10 minutes to work, the front disk brake is now hitting the pads without me touching the breaks. I’ve just got off my bike and walked up into my flat and I could hear the pads were rubbing against the disk without me touching the break lever. I will be ringing them and asking for a full refund or a new bike as this one was not set up properly. I’ve never known a bike to have this many faults so fast. The bike was obviously not built properly and these sort of things do not happen on delivery because it’s several issues and not just one.

Before I made my purchase of a Specialized Aethos Pro (2023 model), I asked whether the bike was likely to undergo any further reductions and was told no, it would and could not be reduced more because the margins were already so small. I have come to write this review after testing the bike for about a month, and find that they have taken another £300 off the price I paid. There is clearly quite a lot of stock and I should have waited to buy. I'm sure this sales tactic is standard practice, but it has left a very sour taste. I shall be going elsewhere the next time I make the significant financial decision to purchase such an expensive bike.The bike itself is of the usual high quality you expect for Specialized products in the 'enthusiast' bracket (Pro/S-works). It is slightly lighter than the Tarmac of equivalent spec., easier to work on (less cable integration), and has the same geometry (except for a slightly longer head tube, which I have noticed seems to give a greater sense of stability on descents).

title: I’ve used Halfords/Tyres on the Drive…
review: I’ve used Halfords/Tyres on the Drive multiple times, but my recent experience was shockingly poor.I had three tyres fitted by a technician, and initially, everything seemed fine. However, I quickly realised that the wheels hadn't been balanced – a major oversight. This was evident because the old weights were still attached to the alloy.I contacted Halfords, and they promptly arranged for another technician to visit the following day. He confirmed my concerns: not only had the wheels not been balanced, but the old valves were reused instead of the TPMS valves I had specifically ordered. After the technician balanced the wheels properly, my car finally drove smoothly.The next day, I contacted Halfords again about the missing TPMS valves. They informed me that I had been refunded for them, but I would need to pay again if I still wanted them. This was unacceptable, considering I had already paid for these valves, and the first technician failed to install them. It was only thanks to the second technician's diligence that I became aware of this issue – otherwise, I wouldn't have known until checking my tyre pressures later on. It’s appalling that the original technician not only skipped this crucial step but had the nerve to put the old valves back on!Halfords did agree to send another technician to install the TPMS valves free of charge, but unfortunately, this has caused a new issue. My car now has terrible wheel wobbling and vibration, clearly indicating another problem with the balancing.Safe to say, I will not be using their services again. I now have to pay another company to correct the balancing issue.The 3-star rating is solely for the handling of my complaint and the professionalism of the second and third technicians who came out. However, the overall experience was lazy, negligent, and made me feel extremely unsafe.

title: Hard work, but good service eventually
review: I booked a fitting for Sunday and received a message on Saturday claiming they had tried to call me, which was categorically untrue as I had no missed calls. Since I was traveling, I couldn't return their call as requested, so I used their live chat instead. Unfortunately, this feature is essentially useless. The bot asked a series of repetitive and irrelevant questions before finally connecting me to an agent. After answering a few questions, the chat was abruptly ended without any resolution.On the morning of the appointment, I received a text, so I assumed everything was on track. However, by 7:50 PM, I still hadn't heard anything about my 8-8 booking. When I called customer service, I was informed that the tyres were not available and was forced to reschedule for Tuesday, causing me to take time off work.On the positive side, the agent I spoke to on the phone was helpful despite my (regrettable) frustration. The fitter who came on Tuesday was slightly late but had a good reason and offered useful advice. While I can't give 5 stars due to the initial communication issues, I also can't give 1 star as they eventually resolved everything.

You would think with expensive items like bikes, the driver would at least try the door, and if no one is in, leave with a neighbour or leave a card so a re-delivery could be organised.

review: Bike arrived with different spec on it which I wasn’t keen on. Apparently the spec changed more than a year ago so but they hadn’t bothered to update their website.They are a nightmare to get hold of. The other reviews are not kidding. Emails go unanswered and calls will ring out. There is a big but though. When you do manage to get hold of them (hours of ringing) they are very pleasant and helpful. I spoke to two different people who very friendly and helpful. They took the bike back, covered return cost and refunded me after a few calls chasing them. Because of this I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again. If you have a problem you’ll need to be super committed to getting hold of them but otherwise they seem very nice.

review: Very pleased with my bike from Winstanleys, best price found. My only suggestion would be to include some basic instructions in with the bike for those of us who have never assembled a thru-axle wheel before.
